nom: Banila Co Clean it Zero Green Peel Toner Pads

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin (including large-pored, T-zone, and acne-prone variants) report the pads exfoliate, remove excess oil, unclog and tighten pores, and leave skin feeling clearer and less greasy over repeated use.
segments.combination: Reviewers describing combination or combination-oily skin report the pads remove excess end-of-day oil without drying out their skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin (including one with eczema) report the pads cleanse without irritation and leave skin hydrated, though one notes the scent could be strong for sensitive noses.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 30s with oily, occasionally acne-prone skin reports the pads leave her face fully clean of makeup and sunscreen residue.

concerns.aging: No reviewer specifically links this product to visible aging concerns; mentions are limited to general radiance rather than fine lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention hydration report the pads leave skin feeling moisturized, soft, or hydrated rather than stripped; none report dryness or tightness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the pads calm redness and help breakouts clear faster; no dissent noted.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the pads balance oil and strengthen the skin's natural barrier without irritation; no other reviews address barrier function directly.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describe improved texture, brightness, and reduced pore appearance; one reviewer struggling with large pores and dullness reports visibly smaller-looking pores and clearer skin after a few uses.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report fewer breakouts, faster clearing of existing ones, or no new blemishes; no reviewer in this set reports worsened acne or cystic breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple oily-skin reviewers report reduced oil, controlled T-zone shine, and a mattified, balanced feel after use; no reviewer with oily skin reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Pleasant green tea or citrus scent
Fragrance may be strong for sensitive noses
Soft yet effective dual-sided exfoliating texture

extraits.texte: The Banilla Co Clean It Zero Green Peel Toner pad is the best toner pad I've used. I have very oily skin so toning is a necessity for me. I usually get the toner & add it to a cotton pad, but this product simplifies that process. They are presoaked & I love that it includes tweezers to help remove the pads. The actual texture is what really won me over. Most toning pads are too rough & harsh, in my opinion. These are rough enough to slightly exfoliate, but not feel scratchy. The actual formula on the pads effectively clarifies & balanced my skin. I'm having no oily issues on the days I use this product. I'm so happy I've discovered this brand. I see why the K-Beauty craze is alive & well. I'd highly recommend for oily, unbalanced skin.

extraits.titre: Great for a quick cleanse or pick me up
extraits.texte: I use these when I'm too lazy to do mh fill face routine. They cleanse well and don't irritate my sensitive (eczema) face. The pads are large and it comes with little tweezer picks so you don't have to dirty the pads. Kinda spendy but would get again.

extraits.titre: I would buy this product again and again ❤️
extraits.texte: As someone who struggles with oily, congested skin, finding the right skincare products can often feel like an endless battle. However, my quest for clearer, balanced skin led me to Banila Co's Clean it Zero Green Peel Toner Pads, and I'm thrilled to say that they've become a game-changer in my routine. From the moment I opened the jar, I was impressed by the promise of highly concentrated, vegan dual-sided toner pads packed with skin-clearing ingredients and exfoliants. The convenience of having a powerful treatment in a pre-soaked pad format appealed to my busy lifestyle, and I was eager to put them to the test. Using the toner pads just three times a week, as recommended, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and clarity. The dual-sided design allowed me to gently exfoliate and remove dead skin cells with one side, while the other side balanced oil production and strengthened my skin's natural barrier. What truly sets these toner pads apart is their clinically proven formula. Dermatologist tested and vegan-friendly, they effectively target excess oil, buildup, dead skin cells, and breakouts without causing any irritation or dryness. Instead, my skin felt refreshed, soothed, and noticeably clearer after each use. I appreciated the versatility of these pads—they can be used anytime, anywhere, making them a convenient solution for on-the-go skincare. Whether I'm at home or traveling, I can rely on these pads to keep my skin feeling balanced and refreshed th

I use makeup cloths to remove the makeup from my face after cleansing. But, I always feel like I need to use a exfoliant or toner afterwards. I tried the Clean it Zero green peel toner pads and I love how it removed my waterproof eye make-up and left my skin feeling much brighter and smooth. I have combination skin, but I tend to be more oily, especially at the end of the day. The toner pad removed my excess oil and didn't dry out my skin. The packaging is really well designed and includes little tongs to pick up only one toner pad at a time. Other toner pads that I've tried in the past are hard to pick up and you end up picking up a few and putting the extras back in. Which then causes them to dry out. Not a problem with these toner pads. They never dried out! Also, after cleaning my face, I used the pads on my elbows. I don't have really rough elbows, but what does it hurt?! Clean ingredients and clean skin. Best clean product I've used in awhile! Gifted by Banila Co.

extraits.titre: Finally feel like all my makeup and sunscreen is removed!
extraits.texte: I'm 39 with very oily and sometimes acne prone skin. I'm used to applying toners with my hands, so applying with a pad was new to me, and I LOVE it! After I wash my face, I'm sometimes left wondering if there is any makeup or sunscreen remaining. These peel pads ensure that my face is clean and ready for a fresh start. Love that there is LHA for a gentle exfoliation, just make sure to wear sunscreen when using a product with an exfoliant in them. Let's talk about the packaging, love the little tongs that come in the cap! The tongs ensure that you don't contaminate any of the pads with dirt or oil that might be on your hands. gifted by Banila Co

I was gifted by Banilla Co and have been using them every night before bedtime. First of all I want to say that they smell so good! The skin feels super clean afterwards. It removes completely all my makeup very easy. When I wake up my skin feels so soft and moisturized. I usually suffer with acne but since I started using these pads I didn't have a single one. It really cleans my skin and remove the oily spots. I want to mention as well that the pads are so thin which makes this container last for very long. It's a 10/10 product.

extraits.titre: YOU NEED THIS IN YOUR LIFE!
extraits.texte: I received these pads as a gifted from Banila Co and I LOVE THESE PADS! I have oily acne prone skin and I have a lot of texture too. These pads gently exfoliates my skin and I've noticed my skin texture has been improved and my skin looks radiant and feeling soft. These doesn't irritates or peel my skin off and it helps me to calm when breaks out.
